Pork Sinigang (Filipino Sour Soup) 🍲
Serves 6

Ingredients
1 kg pork spare ribs, cut into pieces
1 large onion, quartered
3 tomatoes, quartered
1 radish (labanos), sliced
1 bunch kangkong (water spinach)
1 cup string beans, cut into 2-inch pieces
1 eggplant, sliced
1 pack (40 g) sinigang mix
2 tbsp fish sauce (patis)
8 cups water
3 green chilies

Instructions
1. In a large pot, bring the water and pork to a boil. Skim off the scum.
2. Add the onion and tomatoes and simmer for 45 minutes until tender.
3. Add the radish, string beans and eggplant and cook for 5 minutes.
4. Stir in the sinigang mix and fish sauce. Add the kangkong and chilies.
Serve hot with rice.
